authorities.notes: Clean-param consolidates tracking duplicates; Disallow takes priority over Clean-param; prefer Clean-param over Disallow for non-content-changing params
GET parameter indexing can also be managed in Webmaster; conflicts prefer the rule that prevents indexing
Supports user-agent/allow/disallow/sitemap; longest match; least restrictive on conflict; ignores unsupported directives such as Clean-param; BOM ignored

syntax_verdict: OLYA ROBOTS SYNTAX AUDIT COMPLETE — valid User-agent groups; Allow/Disallow/Sitemap ok; Clean-param Yandex-only; wildcards used are Google/Yandex-compatible; minimal corrections only where proven
